card.subtitle: Maya sets up her tip jar

text: I'm a creator, and this is how I receive tips: my fans send me Tessera pre-IPO tokens, not cash.
My Solana wallet is my account. No signup, no password.
I add my name and my X handle, and my tip link is ready. The link is my wallet, so there's no database.
My followers see this card on X, and the same link works as a Solana Blink.
Now I'm the fan. I open the creator's link: the jar is empty.
One click, and my wallet is connected.
I pick the pre-IPO token I want to give, at its live Jupiter price: three dollars in USDC.
I approve once. Jupiter swaps my USDC into the token and sends it straight to the creator.
I can also lock a tip, so the creator holds it. Before approving, I see Tessera's redemption warning and a small refundable deposit. Here, the lock is two minutes.
Back on my side, I open my jar: what I've received, my tip history, and the locked tip counting down.
When a lock opens, I claim it, and the tokens are mine.
And I get my escrow deposit back.
This isn't a mockup. It's live on Solana mainnet: this jar got its first real tip on September 24th, in a single transaction.
Swap, escrow and transfer in one transaction, for a fraction of a cent. Only on Solana.
